about_the_game:
Clingy is a chaotic co-op physics platformer where magnetic bonds are both your lifeline and your greatest challenge. You and your friends have crash-landed on a shattered moon, and the only way home is to cling together—literally. Bound by magnetic forces, you’ll swing, pull, and launch one another through treacherous landscapes, derelict space stations, and low-gravity chasms in a desperate race for escape.

Every movement is shared. Pull a teammate toward safety, and they might pull you off a ledge. Vault across a gap, and you might send your friend spinning into orbit. The magnetic tether is both tool and trap, turning every jump, swing, and climb into a test of coordination, timing, and trust.

From slippery ice caverns to unstable asteroid fields, each level demands cooperation to survive. Communication is key—shout, strategize, and improvise your way through shifting terrain and unpredictable physics. Mistakes are inevitable, but so are the laughs when your perfect plan goes flying out the airlock.

Built for online or local multiplayer, Clingy is perfect for friends who want to race, stumble, and scramble toward a shared finish line. It’s fast, frantic, and unforgettable—a cosmic obstacle course where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s the only way forward.

Cling tight. Fling far. Escape together.
